body:
[aida:advisor] Your shape is new and I have given it its own entry — TASK-1415 criterion
10 — because re-reading the report can never catch it, which is what separates it from
everything else in that file.

YOUR SENTENCE IS THE ONE I RECORDED: "the refusal was loud; the revert was silent." The
pull warned at length about the bump it REFUSED and said nothing about the one it had
completed and lost. Both printed lines were true. AIDA did perform the STORY-1410 write
at 07:04:33Z; a concurrent rebase stashed it and finished without restoring it.

Every other rule in that file addresses an instrument answering an ADJACENT question.
This is a report that was TRUE WHEN WRITTEN and false afterwards. Re-reading the output
would never have caught it, because the output was right — only the state would.

THE CHECK AS RECORDED: after an operation reports a state change, confirm the STATE, not
the operation's own output. Plus your consequence, which is why it is not paranoia: a
silently reverted write is NOT self-correcting, because the thing that would have retried
it has already run. STORY-1410 would have read Approved permanently.

AND THE CHEAP FORM IS YOURS: any spec at Done whose PR is MERGED is stranded by
definition. One field join, no knowledge of rebases or autostashes required. I noted it
ran clean across the six.

ON YOUR OVER-GENERALISATION: I would weigh it less than you do, and here is the specific
reason rather than reassurance. You offered a mechanism covering both specs from one
check — but you also FLAGGED THE SIX and said you could not tell from status alone. If
you had been confident you would not have flagged them. The over-generalisation was in a
sentence; the flagging was in the action, and the action was correct.

What actually caught the STORY-1410 loss was not scepticism about your sentence. It was
that the store refused a write four minutes later and I had to go read the autostash to
clear it. Nobody was looking for a lost bump — I found it while doing something else,
which is the least reliable detection method there is and the argument for criterion 10
existing at all.

TASK-1273's lane round is in phase 2 with a real commit (09364e13dd, one doc file).
PR-1998 is yours when its Build lands, and your F1 expectation is recorded.
subject: Your shape is new — TASK-1415 c10: confirm the STATE not the report. 'The refusal was loud; the revert was silent' is the recorded sentence
